### Patch Changes

- [#609](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/pull/609) [`034b070`](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/commit/034b07032f81ec6e9692f2463cdcb88b77a5d893) Thanks [@huntie](https://github.com/huntie)! - Keep slide text left-aligned in the overview grid and every other thumbnail instead of inheriting the host's alignment.

- [#588](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/pull/588) [`d12e3e1`](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/commit/d12e3e1d8b208d326f3fce370e42bede3fb96b74) Thanks [@1weiho](https://github.com/1weiho)! - Show New deck before an agent is connected, so first-time users can create a deck and install an agent from the panel.

- [#599](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/pull/599) [`2f7edd0`](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/commit/2f7edd01405e3da1d63d603ce4efe09568da3e97) Thanks [@Ruxiu0409](https://github.com/Ruxiu0409)! - Keep slide text left-aligned in the mobile thumbnail strip instead of inheriting the button's centered alignment.

- [#589](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/pull/589) [`557b56e`](https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide/commit/557b56e277277ff16860eb7398fffae962866f0c) Thanks [@1weiho](https://github.com/1weiho)! - Fade to black when entering and leaving present mode, and nudge the slide with a hint when stepping past the last slide.

detail.readme: # open-slide The slide framework built for agents. Describe a deck, and your coding agent writes it as React. open-slide handles the canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, editing, and present mode. Every page is a React component rendered on a fixed 1920 × 1080 canvas. ```bash npx @open-slide/cli init my-deck cd my-deck npm run dev ``` [Documentation](https://open-slide.dev/docs) · [Changelog](https://open-slide.dev/changelog) ## Agent panel Connect the Claude Code or Codex CLI you already use and drive it from the browser. Press `A` on any slide to open the panel. ![The agent panel beside the canvas while Claude Code edits the open deck](.github/assets/agent-panel.webp) - **Draft a deck.** Click New deck on the home page and describe it. The agent writes it page by page while the canvas follows along. - **Edit what you see.** The current slide, page, and selected element go along with every message, so "make this bigger" just works. - **Apply comments** with one click from the comment bar. - **Uses your existing login.** The SDK installs into the workspace the first time you open the panel. No API keys to configure. Prefer the terminal? The bundled skills (`/create-slide`, `/apply-comments`, `/create-theme`) work with any coding agent, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others. ## Comment mode Press `C`, click an element or drag across a region, and leave a note. Notes are saved as `@slide-comment` markers in the source, and the agent applies them all in one pass. ![Comment mode with pinned notes beside the slide](.github/assets/comment-mode.webp) ## Present mode Fullscreen playback with keyboard navigation, and a presenter view with the next slide, speaker notes, and a timer. ![Presenter view with the current slide, next slide, speaker notes, and timer](.github/assets/presenter.webp) ## Also included - Visual editor with drag, resize, alignment guides, and inline text editing - Themes, page transitions, step-by-step reveals, and shared-element morphs - Assets manager with brand logo search via [svgl](https://svgl.app) and Google Fonts - Export to static HTML, PDF, and PPTX - Static build that deploys to Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or any static host ## Repository | Path | Description | | --- | --- | | [`packages/core`](packages/core) | `@open-slide/core`: runtime, Vite plugin, and the `open-slide` CLI | | [`packages/cli`](packages/cli) | `@open-slide/cli`: the `init` scaffolder and project template | | [`apps/demo`](apps/demo) | Local workspace for developing the framework | | [`apps/web`](apps/web) | Website and docs | ```bash pnpm install pnpm dev # run the demo against local core pnpm build # build all packages pnpm typecheck pnpm check # biome pnpm test ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. ## Support If open-slide is useful to you, consider supporting development: ## License MIT © [Yiwei Ho](https://github.com/1weiho)
